facts.fact: Lei n.º 22/11, arts 33-34, makes transfer of personal data abroad to a country with adequate protection subject to notification to the APD, and to a country without it subject to APD authorisation on stated grounds such as the data subject's written consent; art. 67 puts the law in force on publication, 17 June 2011.
facts.system: Lei n.º 22/11 da Protecção de Dados Pessoais

note: No published list of countries, model terms or procedure appears; art. 34 leaves contract conditions for the APD to determine.
